title: Vectors
summary: A vector has magnitude and direction (velocity, force); a scalar has magnitude only (mass, time, distance, work). a = a₁i + a₂j + a₃k has |a| = √(a₁² + a₂² + a₃²) and unit vector â = a/|a|. a₁i, a₂j, a₃k are the component vectors of a.
Position vector of the point dividing AB internally in m : n: (mb + na)/(m + n). Centroid: (a + b + c)/3. Collinear vectors are scalar multiples of each other (a₁/b₁ = a₂/b₂ = a₃/b₃).
a·b = |a||b| cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃. a ⊥ b ⇔ a·b = 0. Projection of a on b = a·b/|b|. i·i = 1, i·j = 0. |b − a|² = |a|² + |b|² − 2a·b.
a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂ = determinant |i j k; a₁ a₂ a₃; b₁ b₂ b₃|. b × a = −(a × b). i × j = k, j × k = i, k × i = j. |a × b|² + (a·b)² = |a|²|b|² (Lagrange's identity).
Area of a parallelogram with sides a, b = |a × b|; with diagonals d₁, d₂ = ½|d₁ × d₂|. A unit vector perpendicular to a and b is (a × b)/|a × b|.
[a b c] = a·(b × c) = the 3 × 3 determinant of the components. Three vectors are coplanar when [a b c] = 0; four points A, B, C, D are coplanar when [AB AC AD] = 0.

objective4: Answer: (i) What are xi, yj, zk called for r = xi + yj + zk? (ii) If |OA| = 4, |OB| = 5, |OC| = 6 along the axes, express OP. (iii) The centroid of ΔABC with position vectors a, b, c? (iv) The point dividing AB internally in 2 : 3?

(i) The component vectors of r along the axes.
(ii) OP = 4i + 5j + 6k.
(iii) (a + b + c)/3.
(iv) (2b + 3a)/(2 + 3) = (3a + 2b)/5.
objective6: a = i + j + k and b = i − j + k. (a) Find a × b. (b) Find the angle between a and b. (c) Find the projection of a on b. (d) Is a × b = b × a? (e) Find the area of the parallelogram with a and b as diagonals. (f) Check whether |a × b|² = |a|²|b|² − (a·b)².
a = i + j + k and b = i + j. (a) a·b; (b) a unit vector ⊥ both; (c) area with a and b as diagonals; (d) verify |a × b|² = a²b² − (a·b)²; (e) |2b × a|; (f) is a × b = b × a?

(a) 1 + 1 + 0 = 2.
(b) a × b = |i j k; 1 1 1; 1 1 0| = −i + j + 0k; unit vector (−i + j)/√2.
(c) ½|a × b| = ½√2 = √2/2.
(d) |a × b|² = 2; a²b² − (a·b)² = 3·2 − 4 = 2. Verified.
(e) |2b × a| = 2|a × b| = 2√2.
(f) No — they are opposite vectors.
